per_credit_hour_charges.line: Tuition for dual enrollment courses is $155 per credit hour, and most available courses are three or four credit hours. For one semester, a three-credit course costs $625, and one four-credit course costs $780 in tuition.

Yes! Dual enrollment tuition is reduced for high school students. For the same courses, dual enrollment students in high school pay $155 per credit, compared to $800 per credit for regular undergraduate tuition.
